| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534357/631458858/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=) Derek –

Summer is in full swing and record-breaking temperatures are expected this weekend – so however you plan to celebrate, make sure you’re staying hydrated and safe.

But as we gather with family and friends, this Fourth of July calls for something more than cookouts and fireworks (which we plan to enjoy, too). As America turns 250, it’s worth pausing to reflect on what it truly means to be American – and what we’re willing to fight for. \-------------- **A Somber Milestone** Tomorrow also marks one year since Donald Trump’s so-called “One Big Beautiful Bill” was signed into law. In Virginia, the consequences have been swift and real: three rural clinics have closed their doors, utility bills keep climbing, and later this year an estimated 310,000 Virginians are expected to lose access to health care – timed, not coincidentally, to land after the November elections.

Our social safety net has been hollowed out so the wealthiest among us can pocket more tax breaks.

**We couldn’t stop this bill from becoming law, but we _will_ hold the politicians who passed it accountable this November.** \-------------- **Mark’s Been on the Road** Over the past month, Senator Warner has been doing what he does best: showing up and listening. Here’s a couple highlights from our many campaign stops:

Louisa & Fluvanna Counties – Senator Warner joined Tom Perriello at a meet and greet hosted by local Democrats, where conversations ranged from data center development in rural communities to the corruption coming out of the White House. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534359/631458861/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=) Glen Allen – At a community conversation with voters of all ages, residents shared ideas for future legislation, raised concerns about responsible AI use in schools, and talked about how to better care for Virginia’s most vulnerable. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534360/631458863/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=) Lawrenceville – Senator Warner met with Democrats from across Brunswick County and heard firsthand about the urgent need to protect rural hospitals and expand broadband access. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534362/631458864/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=) Danville – We are thrilled to announce the opening of our new regional office in Southside Virginia. Senator Warner was there to cut the ribbon and meet with our energized team of field organizers and volunteers. We will need all hands on deck to send Tom Perriello back to Congress and flip VA-05 blue this November. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534363/631458867/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=) Tomorrow, Senator Warner will be walking in the Fairfax and Dale City Independence Day parades. If you are in the area, we hope to see you there! \-------------- **Grab your Swag!** If you can’t beat the heat, then at least look good in it! From Mark’s classic ‘90s logo, to our chic tote bag ready to hold sunscreen – our union-printed merch has something for everyone. Trust us, you’ll want to stock up now: | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534364/631458868/-883765163?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=&emci=5d3455a2-6475-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=46c42216-df76-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=4568237) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534365/631458869/1180868477?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=&emci=5d3455a2-6475-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=46c42216-df76-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=4568237) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534366/631458870/-1267305483?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=&emci=5d3455a2-6475-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=46c42216-df76-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=4568237)

\--------------
**Before you go...**
Mark Warner has been in Virginia politics a long time – and as a numbers guy, he knows something important: he can’t do it alone.

Winning in November is more than holding this Senate seat. It means showing up everywhere to elect Democrats up and down the ballot – town halls from the Shenandoah Valley to the Eastern Shore, canvasses in every corner of the Commonwealth, and building the infrastructure to win in 2026 and beyond. It means paid staff on the ground, events in every corner of the Commonwealth, and making sure every Virginia voter hears what’s at stake.

That’s what your support makes possible.
[_**If you haven’t had a chance to join our team of grassroots donors, will you complete your first donation to Senator Warner’s reelection campaign today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134534369/631458873/-1133191615?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260703_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmM0MjIxNi1kZjc2LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BF9E3G5bgm-2DfWJ5u72-Wgsnhv7psdm3KUvZBnvnqI=)
Thank you for being a critical part of this team. None of this is possible without you.

More very soon,

Team Warner

| | Hi Peter,

Tomorrow, we'll celebrate one of my favorite holidays.

Independence Day is more than fireworks, parades, and backyard cookouts. It's a day to remember the extraordinary men and women who pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor to establish a nation unlike any the world had ever seen.

**Two hundred and fifty years later, America is still the greatest country on Earth.**

We're blessed to live in a nation where freedom isn't given by government, it comes from God.

It's a nation built on faith, personal responsibility, and the belief that every generation has a duty to leave America stronger than they found it.

Those ideals are worth celebrating. They're also worth defending.

**I'm asking patriots like you to join me by making a special $25.00 contribution in honor of 250 years of American greatness!**

Hi Peter,

Today, before you log off to celebrate America’s 250th anniversary, I am reaching out with a reality check.

**In the year 2026, women’s rights, opportunities, and overall well-being are experiencing a backslide in American society. While we are fortunate to have much more freedom and opportunity than ever before, something alarming is happening for women in America – and we cannot take our progress for granted.**

[**Help fight for our nation's future generations of women and girls by pitching in $5 today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134538384/631471566/-1272733520?refcode=EM_F_260703backslide_N_NS_90DO_7_G_TestB_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRjMGE1OTMxLWUxNzYtZjExMS1hYzljLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dLMEcjHx_XoTcA0Zh3dPH0VNoxRmAQrA3fGbv7SqqWc=)

Please keep in mind: The rights women have today were never handed to us by the men in power. Women fought tirelessly for them. They committed to never giving up and won SO MANY critical battles. We owe it to those women to defend against the backslide that powerful forces of 2026 (MAGA, AI, tech giants, the manosphere, etc...) have made all too real.

A growing number of states are considering laws restricting birth control, Trump is tirelessly pushing for the dangerous SAVE America Act, which would make it harder (or impossible) for some married women to vote, and women are literally dying preventable deaths because doctors are too afraid to treat their miscarriages.

**Her Bold Move is on the front lines in the continued fight to ensure women’s hard-fought progress doesn’t disappear. body:

| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, She was just a child. And the person who should have protected her was the one who first trafficked her. Her own mother. What began there didn’t stop. She was sold again and again. Passed between people who saw her as an object. Not a child.
Not a life.
Not someone worth protecting.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
As the years went on, the trauma only grew deeper. To survive, she turned to addiction - the only way to numb the pain. The only way to keep going. She even had children with one of the men who trafficked her. Another chain and reason it felt impossible to escape. For years, she lived in fear. No way out. Until one day, she reached a breaking point. With nothing but courage and fear in her heart, she ran, fleeing to a women’s shelter. No plan. No safety.
**Just hope that maybe someone would help her.** **And that is when everything began to change.** **Because someone did show up.** A partner of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** called House Parent Project. They didn’t turn her away. They didn’t question her worth. **They sat with her, they listened and believed her. And in that moment, light entered her story.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
They helped her take the next step.Then the next. And the next. They safely relocated her far from the people who had controlled her life. **For the first time in years, she could breathe.** She could begin to heal. But they didn’t stop there. They are still walking with her today, because her fight is not over. Her children are still connected to the man who trafficked her. And now, Sara is fighting to bring them to safety. Fighting to break the cycle for good. And she is not alone.
---
Friend, maybe this is your first time hearing about us. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists for one reason: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We were born from the true story told in the film _Sound of Freedom,_ but this mission did not end when the credits rolled. It became a movement. Today, we work around the world to **prevent trafficking before it starts.** **We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
**Because rescue is only the beginning.** Children need safety, healing and someone to walk with them on the long road ahead. **And that is what your support makes possible.** **Not just escape. But restoration. A future rebuilt.** You see, Friend, **Sound of Freedom Foundation’s** mission is simple: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We extend the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it.

**We believe in a future where this evil is gone.** **_A world where every child is safe and truly free._** Jesus said, _“Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”_ (Matthew 18:5) **Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and****be part of that light.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
Your gift today can help: **$25** — Support immediate outreach and response
**$50** — Provide critical care and stabilization
**$75** — Help relocate and protect a survivor
**$100** — Support ongoing care and legal advocacy **Because healing takes time.**
**Protection takes people.**
**And freedom takes courage from all of us.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
You can step in and help rewrite stories like Sara’s. Please give as generously as you can today. And please pray... **For Sara.**
**For her children.**
**And for every child still waiting for someone to show up.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
**Because**** _God’s children are not for sale._** And together... we will not stop fighting for them. For God’s Children,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._A/sen827e14c4)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

Here's what she left out: Flanagan sat on the legislative committee that held hearings on Minnesota's childcare fraud, years before it exploded into the $9 billion scandal that just ended Tim Walz's career. **She knew. She had a seat on the committee._She did nothing_.**

She spent years calling herself Tim Walz's "co-governor." Now that the fraud is front-page news, she wants to be a senator, not held accountable.

That's not just radical - Omar herself calls Flanagan a fighter against "the system." That's incompetence, dressed up as leadership.

**Minnesota deserves better.**

The choice is stark:
> **_Peggy Flanagan:_** Ilhan Omar-endorsed, co-governor during the worst fraud scandal in state history, more of the same failed oversight.
>
> **_Adam Schwarze:_** a former Navy SEAL who understands accountability isn't optional.
I didn't serve in the SEALs for recognition. I served because when something's broken, you fix it - you don't look away for years and hope no one notices.

# [Billion Dollar Bribe? Subpoena and Release Trump’s Crypto Records](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1dd36036-3013-4874-8bc3-7677ac34ac2a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

See link below)_ When someone gives more than $200 to a presidential candidate, that must be publicly reported, for all of us to see. This is done to help prevent corruption. **So why the hell should a billion dollars worth of gifts be kept private?** **[Add your name: Demand Congress Subpoena and Publicly Release Trump’s Crypto Records](https://default.salsalabs.org/T64118dc6-684d-4560-8446-a2dd859275cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** When a president makes a fortune from crypto while in office, the public must know who the hell that money is coming from. Especially when it includes heaving piles of bullsh*t that no investor in their right mind would buy, like the Trump commemorative crypto coin. So what exactly are the buyers buying? Congress can subpoena these records, and release them to the public. And since Republicans control Congress (for now) they need to make it happen. This is the kind of thing that pisses off even the MAGA base. And with Trump losing support, and midterm elections just a few months away, Congressional Republicans are frantically looking for ways to start moving away from Trump, and distance themselves from the stench. Here’s their chance. Make them do it. Ahead of Independence Day, I’ve been thinking a lot about the future of
our democracy — the kind of country we’ll hand over to future generations.

We’ve learned something over the last ten years,
Derek: Democracy isn’t guaranteed.

When Donald Trump tried to throw out Pennsylvanians’ ballots in the
aftermath of the 2020 election and declare himself the winner, I didn’t
sit on my hands and just hope democracy would prevail. I took action.

I took the president and his allies to court 43 times to make sure every
eligible ballot was counted. And
Derek, we won. All 43 times.

Now, with Donald Trump back in the White House, that same fight for the
fundamental freedom to cast your ballot in a free, fair, and accessible
election has returned.

But I want you to hear me on this: Donald Trump can launch any nationwide
crusade he wants. He can say whatever he wants, even sign his name to
whatever he wants. It won’t change a simple fact:

As long as I’m Governor, Pennsylvania will always put democracy over the
desires of a wannabe-tyrant. Just like we did 250 years ago.

body:
Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105464?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1)
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we needed diapers and health insurance for our growing family.
Working at Kellogg’s used to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that let you become a homeowner, live decently, and hopefully retire some day.
But over the years, that changed. Workers were paid less. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans were gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105464?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1)
Most of us had never walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines through the dead of the winter if we had to. We were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks in the cold, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying union jobs.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105464?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1)
Following the strike, I was fired. Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
Instead, I decided last year to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and we nearly won. I got 47% of the vote in one of the closest Senate races in the country.
**Now, I’m running again for the U.S. Senate – this time against billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts – and the first poll shows us virtually TIED: 46% to 45%.**
I am taking on a literal billionaire senator. We can finish what we started last year and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat for working class people, but I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this seat.
**[Please, will you contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate and Heartland Patriots to help me defeat billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts here and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105464?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1)**
If you have stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Dan Osborn and Heartland Patriots will process instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105465?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105464?refcode=em20260703-10646&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=10646%2E614464%2E4jjKy1)

subject: I Can't Do This Without You
body:
This campaign is powered by people like you. Not corporations. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMUOS4HeVvfmscBPlPRAgpkDEziezgtKrXjuDy5eJDcjRJNOVndPp-iRW-yHbE22q-wgMttH4O70fDCtXDjWtuopQmEa8BnpJbPQl--0oVqOmdHPqTx9noyYQFaNTvJEmQEFGLfZ7pQm7kttSF107Y6NGLJOY9T1jQM-N-bigmk70tq87XIfyA46OydzwN0_LOneCUxeVmyFj_peSxiOo0SU0FEwOtW21F_5dNRs2moIDeGHeMukQV_snJryFHFr2B3bNvQcNMjoI1XNtxkfR4qg/4s0/FTmzeH-eThWi4wygF5688A/h0/h001.GxD0Ws8ZJbR4qLaQBWmOvFJFD7vrNBVJsIT4VCY31gg)
Friend, **** Over the last few emails, I have shared who I am, what I have seen, and why I am running for Congress. Today, I am asking for your help. I live in Nashville, but most people who know me know I am the guy who recommends duct tape for your muffler, who gets called when something needs to be built, or when it is time to go fishing. I collected petition signatures at gun ranges and hardware stores. I have spent years working alongside Hispanic communities in Nashville and Murfreesboro, farmers in Warren County, and families in Grundy and Sequatchie Counties. I am running for Congress to give a voice to the people of my community. I have watched people struggle to find affordable housing. I have watched young people search for good-paying jobs. I have watched communities lose opportunities because we have not invested in workforce development and construction education. We need real training for people who want to become General Contractors. We need real construction standards and a Federal Construction Commission. We need more women in construction. We need a clear pathway to success through education, apprenticeships, certifications, and on-the-job training. **Workforce training, affordable housing, and a cleaner earth** are connected. We can train people, build homes, create careers, and strengthen communities. I have spent my life building things that last. Now I am trying to build something bigger. I would like to be on the right side of history when people look back on the 2026 election. One day I hope to tell my grandchildren that I tried to make a difference. I have watched people in my community struggle. I have watched freedoms disappear. I have watched friends live in fear. I will no longer sit on the sidelines. clean_body: This campaign is powered by people like you. Not corporations. | | | Friend, ** Over the last few emails, I have shared who I am, what I have seen, and why I am running for Congress. Today, I am asking for your help. I live in Nashville, but most people who know me know I am the guy who recommends duct tape for your muffler, who gets called when something needs to be built, or when it is time to go fishing. I collected petition signatures at gun ranges and hardware stores. I have spent years working alongside Hispanic communities in Nashville and Murfreesboro, farmers in Warren County, and families in Grundy and Sequatchie Counties. I am running for Congress to give a voice to the people of my community. I have watched people struggle to find affordable housing. I have watched young people search for good-paying jobs. I have watched communities lose opportunities because we have not invested in workforce development and construction education. We need real training for people who want to become General Contractors. We need real construction standards and a Federal Construction Commission. We need more women in construction. We need a clear pathway to success through education, apprenticeships, certifications, and on-the-job training. Workforce training, affordable housing, and a cleaner earth** are connected. We can train people, build homes, create careers, and strengthen communities. I have spent my life building things that last. Now I am trying to build something bigger. I would like to be on the right side of history when people look back on the 2026 election. One day I hope to tell my grandchildren that I tried to make a difference. I have watched people in my community struggle. I have watched freedoms disappear. I have watched friends live in fear. I will no longer sit on the sidelines. The people of Tennessee deserve representation that listens, works hard, and tells the truth. This campaign will not take corporate money. It is powered by people like you. If you believe in what we are building, I need your help today. Please make a to our campaign. If you cannot donate, please. This weekend, we celebrate America’s 250th birthday. This milestone calls for celebration, but also for reflection on what it truly means to be active participants in the great American experiment.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP47/1/105057/images/26-SDS/Suhas_Parade_Crowd.jpg]
When the Declaration of Independence was signed, its authors put forward a radical idea: that all people are created equal and endowed with the unalienable rights of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. Our country has never been perfect, but over time, each generation has fought to make those words more inclusive. Since then, we’ve become a multicultural melting pot, and our belief in and struggle for those values continues.
That ongoing struggle is what makes America worth celebrating.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP47/1/105057/images/26-SDS/Suhas_Parade_McAuliff.jpg]
As we continue to fight for a better world, I hope we remember to celebrate our progress – because that progress didn’t happen on its own. It happened because people like you stayed in the fight. It gives me hope that the next 250 years will be transformational in living up to America’s promise.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP47/1/105057/images/26-SDS/Suhas_Parade_Candy.jpg]
Thank you for being in the fight with me for a better and more just future for all Americans.
–Suhas

PEOPLE-FIRST LEADERSHIP FOR VIRGINIA'S 2ND
* * *
Hi Friend,Before the 4th, we wanted to send a full July update from Team Nila.This campaign is growing because people across Virginia’s 2nd District are stepping forward, showing up, and helping us build something rooted in community, service, and people-first leadership.
### **Thank you to our endorsers**
We are grateful for the growing list of community leaders, faith voices, local advocates, veterans, healthcare voices, civic organizations, and supporters who are standing with Dr. Nila Devanath.Thank you to:
* Tidewater Democratic Socialists of America
* Dr Michael Keyes, Senior Paster New Hope Baptist Church, Virginia Beach
* Minister James Hood, Jr., President, Interdenominational Ministers Conference Virginia Beach
* Dr. Ruby Kochhar, Vice President, Chesapeake Virginia Gurudwara Sahib
* Dr. Pat King, Chesapeake City Councilwoman
* Minister Gary McCollum, Virginia Beach faith-community leader
* Christopher Hearn, Suffolk business-community supporter
* 90 for 90, voting-rights and civic-engagement organization
* Kaytlin Armitage, Psychology PhD Student and Virginia Army National Guard Veteran
* Lydgia L. Girard, Virginia Beach community supporter
* Phyllis Woodhead, Women’s Recovery Group

Every endorsement, every conversation, and every volunteer shift helps show that this campaign is being built by the people who live, work, worship, serve, and organize in this district.
### View Endorsements
<https://niladevanath.com/Endorsements/>

### **What we are up to**
Team Nila is on the move across the district.We are meeting voters, knocking doors, attending community events, listening to families, sharing updates, and making sure people know who Nila is, what she stands for, and why this race matters.Right now, we are focused on:
* Reaching voters directly in their neighborhoods
* Sharing more campaign news and video updates
* Building volunteer teams across the district
* Keeping supporters informed about early voting and voter resources
* Showing up at community events, forums, canvasses, town halls, and local gatherings
* Growing the coalition behind Nila’s people-first campaign

And this is just the beginning. More updates, signup links, and event details will be sent soon.

## **Early voting and voter resources**
Early voting is an important part of this campaign, and we want every supporter to have accurate, up-to-date information.Please use the campaign’s voter resource page and official election resources to check your information, make your plan, and share the correct links with friends, family, and neighbors.**Early Voting & Voter Resources**You can find links and early voting resources on our homepage<https://niladevanath.com/>**Official Virginia Voter Information**<https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation>

## **Campaign news and videos**
There is a lot happening, and we want you to stay connected.Recent campaign updates include:
* A Quiet Rage
* Join the Suffolk Democratic Committee
* COVA Coalition Responses
* Conversation
* Early Voting
* Campaign Update
* Pride Month
* Campaign Announcement

We will be sharing more videos, community updates, and campaign trail moments soon. Please follow along, watch, comment, and share. The more people see Nila directly, the stronger this campaign becomes.

<https://niladevanath.com/news.php>

### Upcoming Team Nila events
More information and signup links are coming soon. For now, please save these dates and watch for the next update.**Eastern Shore**

Congress will be decided six weeks before Election Day.
That's not a prediction. That's a fact.
By the time November arrives, millions of ballots will already be cast — early votes banked during the weeks before Election Day by whichever side worked harder to collect them.
**In 2024, Turning Point PAC worked harder.**
We funded thousands of full-time ballot-chasers into America's swing states. Their mission: Find conservative voters who support the GOP but never quite make it to the polls. Men and women whose ballots sit on kitchen counters — unopened, unreturned, wasted.
Our ballot-chasers knocked their doors, made a plan with them, and put their ballots in the box. All 5 swing states went red. Republicans won _big_.
**We're doing it again in 2026 — and we need your help to fund it.**

[Support Turning Point PAC](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjZ9AAwAAAAAAYwoje1paIj-qo8nSvcDAsHaBnC1gJT1y_BcA6GfCp9CY-ttIwbkonJJkXPHHK-sXuopTayIlWEbwdxDTW7ADPw7NJJ4nR-x_RFFA0dM)

## **News from the Campaign Trail**
|
**History in the Making**
As the July 4th weekend approaches, I’m reminded that York and Lancaster counties are special places – not only because of our beautiful farms, quaint main streets, and close-knit communities, but because our region has helped carry the American story forward for generations. We are surrounded by reminders that history was made here and that the work of democracy belongs to all of us. As we prepare to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, I feel especially grateful to mark that milestone alongside neighbors who care deeply about their communities. While we may not all agree on every issue, I think we can agree that we live in a remarkable place that deserves support and resources to grow and thrive. I hope everyone has a festive, meaningful, and safe celebration. – Nancy
---
|
**Celebrating the Communities of the 11 th District**
The 18th annual **Lancaster Pride Festival** was held June 20 at Penn Medicine Park, where Nancy joined more than 7,200 attendees to celebrate and support Lancaster’s vibrant LGBTQIA+ community and allies.
---
| From June 25–28, Community Memorial Park became Terre Hill’s backyard during **Terre Hill Days**. The celebration featured carnival rides, local food vendors and nonprofits, magicians, live music, and a petting area, with proceeds supporting the park’s upkeep and operations.
---
| On June 26, Nancy attended the **Ag Issues Forum** , sponsored by the Lancaster Chamber of Commerce, which highlighted agriculture’s vital role in Pennsylvania’s economy. The event included a tour of an Amish dairy farm preserved through the **Lancaster Farmland Trust** , whose work helps protect water flowing from farms into the Chesapeake Bay. With grant support, the farm owner built a new barn that keeps runoff out of nearby creeks and improves the Bay’s health. Federal funding makes projects like this possible, and Nancy is committed to continuing these conservation efforts when elected to Congress.
Nancy also joined the **Shrewsbury Parade** , sponsored by the Mason-Dixon 4 Democracy Club, on June 27. Southern York County Democratic candidates for the PA House and Senate, County Commissioner Doug Hoke, and volunteers marched up Main Street as residents lined the route, children gathered candy, bands performed, and fire trucks from across the area joined the procession. Many capped off the celebration at the Shrewsbury Fire Company Carnival.
---
| During **Riverfest** , York and Lancaster County residents commemorated the June 28, 1863, burning of the Columbia-Wrightsville Bridge, a pivotal Civil War event that stopped Confederate troops from moving east. Forced to turn back, those troops headed toward Gettysburg, where the historic battle began three days later. On Sunday, June 28, all 26 remaining bridge piers were set ablaze to honor that moment, Columbia Borough’s 300th anniversary, and America’s 250th birthday.
---

* **Eureka Volunteer Fire Company Parade – Saturday, July 18, steps off at 4:30 pm** in Stewartstown. More info [here](https://matj3.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30mRHkLv9rg1BGyPEFV/a7oZfvSqmvQD).

subject: A literal gold mine in Azerbaijan.
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=7523%2E582294%2EtQ0JGO ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=7523%2E582294%2EtQ0JGO ]Chris Pappas for Senate

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260703_1.Sw3wSv&refcode=em20260703-7523&amount=5&t=1003&akid=7523%2E582294%2EtQ0JGO ][IMG]
Josh Rogers/NHPR

In last week’s GOP debate, John Sununu told a roomful of Republicans he's
running for Senate to send me back to "bussing tables” at my family’s
“chicken restaurant."

He meant it as an insult. As if the people who work in restaurants — who
cook your food, clear your plates, keep family businesses that are the
heart of our state alive — have something to be embarrassed about.

I’m not embarrassed. I’m proud.

My family opened our restaurant over 100 years ago. I know what a 65-hour
week feels like because I've worked one. I know what it means to show up
every day, work hard, and treat the people around you like they matter —
because they do.

John Sununu has never had to work hard a day in his life. He was born into
the Sununu political dynasty. His family's "business" isn't a restaurant
serving New Hampshire families. It owns a literal gold mine in Azerbaijan
that sells minerals to China.

That's what John Sununu calls “honest work.”

New Hampshire workers deserve a senator who knows what a hard day's labor
actually looks like — who fights for small business owners, for restaurant
workers, for every family just trying to make ends meet. John Sununu is
running to protect people like himself. I'm running for everyone else.

He showed us who he is with these elitist comments. Now let’s make sure he
doesn’t represent us.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260703_1.Sw3wSv&amount=5&refcode=em20260703-1&t=1022&akid=7523%2E582294%2EtQ0JGO ]Donate $5 »

John Sununu doesn’t know the real New Hampshire. He doesn’t get how hard
we work — and he sure as hell doesn’t think our labor is worth respecting.

I do. That’s why I’m running for Senate.

— Chris Pappas

Peter, This week, an active-duty Air Force major named Jason Watson climbed the steps of the United States Capitol and called for the impeachment of Donald Trump. He was arrested minutes later.

He knew exactly what it would cost and climbed those steps anyway.
He was willing to surrender his career and his freedom before he would surrender his oath.
I spent 20 years in the Air Force, and I want to tell you what that oath actually means, because most people have never had to weigh it against everything they own.
---
[ **COURAGE OVER COWARDICE** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt825X-fWv4bwYgJ_AIneCQc256G8bliwmbmLBNOtx2pm_fpJlxuLMwnE2sxRvlD_ow82tnH6fSRm-y7rdsygQlKFQsyyfnruxOyEB56zeqc3UgqD9Dfy0Qiunx0E4X9sutlhvZXp5Rl0Gq7oHJ9dDPWvA6ZD29aLqYX-__I1XBIgfXI7Jco0FYp2ckv7-Qe3GD_IwVhH0h8l8_-nkem3O5FAeIhdoVm502QKICOSOqnkzD5xx-gJ9v7BeUAvxOawH3hhjINRNYb3eZZsi_0vyO853UJBFvPLtVtdUynaHz8YrMFZgNBEVdL6NaP10VKboXaAxDxUt7H_m88BRstH_4QjsWAEvsxNssIBkeuZUum3ITDhZ67euJRPSzXBaX8TH5qfCug9YV0-8Xlxv6WUl_ms/4s0/Xl7aVnRbQba96ukjQIC4Ug/h2/h001.FtK6Am0DHtzKPjYMm2-nta3DqghTWa6Ix2i_nBzd5Q8)

When you raise your right hand, you pledge yourself to a set of words written 250 years ago by people who had just risked the noose to be free. You promise to defend those words against anyone who would twist them. And you make that promise understanding it might one day call on you to act and sacrifice everything. Jason Watson looked at this dangerous moment in our history and decided the call had come for him. That kind of courage is the quiet engine that has carried this republic through every dark stretch of its 250 years. [**Help us honor it by sending someone to Congress who still feels the weight of that same oath.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt825X-fWv4bwYgJ_AIneCQc256G8bliwmbmLBNOtx2pm_WsIHT919Ouo9Mb7B4vZFDHexecrfxQHU-dasCTPzlp3kXANcK0uChX8MPG4L4mh_kuSbtAwJsicpZQtLNCmrAj1Y09bygMmYc2lFjUC4Ocjx8jM_M1qjdD8PwZ_XsWlnZQnFT0okqs2ltJFaEznTMSLXlrdlNJ0WwuhIMVSYkCDN3nSx0ixPkGo2j0js1kExqti02egSLN0mojdydRH0mtoyhQwC6-ErVW7jPuE_K9QmsoOXI-OuPkHmHfT-yz4JrldfjnAv0AE8VfhB-JkH801HqeJPrLK48-YLRRirv4i1-gJ6KlM9ZkAo3UskKMo9WqogfW0Znpszrp7EwOL2aa3Mmf_0WffB3a395w4ZN4Y/4s0/Xl7aVnRbQba96ukjQIC4Ug/h3/h001.K2JcglHK6u2axh7u0zlACgFf_GVuZTQoJojH_U3ywqs) Last month, I stood on those same steps with the Take BAC Congress coalition, asking for many of the things Watson stood up for including holding this administration accountable to the Constitution rather than to Donald Trump. The promise I made in 2001 did not dissolve when I folded my uniform for the last time. It came home with me. It sits at my kitchen table. It is the reason I could not look my kids in the eye and do nothing while this administration takes a blowtorch to the Constitution I swore my life to defend. Keith Self swore those same words. He has traded them for a seat at Donald Trump's table and the corruption that comes with it. This week we mark 250 years of a country that has only ever survived because ordinary people kept deciding it was worth their sacrifice. Jason Watson just made his. clean_body: | | Peter, This week, an active-duty Air Force major named Jason Watson climbed the steps of the United States Capitol and called for the impeachment of Donald Trump. He was arrested minutes later. | He knew exactly what it would cost and climbed those steps anyway. He was willing to surrender his career and his freedom before he would surrender his oath. I spent 20 years in the Air Force, and I want to tell you what that oath actually means, because most people have never had to weigh it against everything they own. When you raise your right hand, you pledge yourself to a set of words written 250 years ago by people who had just risked the noose to be free. You promise to defend those words against anyone who would twist them. And you make that promise understanding it might one day call on you to act and sacrifice everything. Jason Watson looked at this dangerous moment in our history and decided the call had come for him. That kind of courage is the quiet engine that has carried this republic through every dark stretch of its 250 years. Last month, I stood on those same steps with the Take BAC Congress coalition, asking for many of the things Watson stood up for including holding this administration accountable to the Constitution rather than to Donald Trump. The promise I made in 2001 did not dissolve when I folded my uniform for the last time. It came home with me. It sits at my kitchen table. It is the reason I could not look my kids in the eye and do nothing while this administration takes a blowtorch to the Constitution I swore my life to defend. Keith Self swore those same words. He has traded them for a seat at Donald Trump's table and the corruption that comes with it. This week we mark 250 years of a country that has only ever survived because ordinary people kept deciding it was worth their sacrifice. Jason Watson just made his. Fellow American - Let me tell you something they don't teach you in Washington.

**I grew up in the back of a bar.**
Not a fancy restaurant. Not a supper club. A beer joint, pool hall, and liquor store on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - the Sanitary Cafe. My parents ran it. We lived behind it. I swept the floors, wiped down the tables, and fell asleep listening to the sounds of working people winding down after a long shift at the textile mill.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=fda701e1c93c463db30456513f5a5b29&_e=NNx6qbH3iElMe1WoX2OX5v5fJCOYw9fgQPcddn_eSfhKjOLHO6R5Os4rVxTvlHsV3u28Szwm_lqVwyxVxr1zOMEXZdlKjzL6NNp6t0qcPXNQyQ4Sj8fZGhBfS3_mBLor_bJaxoYTbX0yhFCyll6tNRaPHRh8bLl578WrU2TuHg9x1Jk9Ou73WlJm6SogG7D4n1F14K_odbEvmaQ7SZk4j0jRmXVsKTT0j0sD4sU6pjYYvzTxiWc72Pw3KsvuZJEZ45Bg4Wg5v22hCPunKJRFfUQ6nRXCW_at-aq4zLTvqQBuEWx90nFCcYyhPoAd3iCLBROhKPaW-QZzyUbsrtNCnjbwBoEEeEAUlHEW1jd6kPYFSgrSZcLWOs4KZ0g6GwOJ4W3zcEj0CM-lm6bGgWG3ZsNfFn9mG2PDJjdqiqGt0MGJKyH7Nxbo8fXJvt7K3xl6ZIj9UU9YeLKdvkXVNtx7rSE1o9DuWwydEsEIcP4lLnV09vuelFbtfbm6n0nB4Cv0NUbXVQy1K5kMYV4qxRoi8XIeInzBEMBSkvjy4rXiYUoy42Ixm4EgSW7BeG5xs6K1UAPoW7mxaxJBf_WJdSbtIzPup6PlUzCOl4mokrWiYZJENMlB1DKRah6LWZE4n8MztVQnjzjJGEFOsEcIKp8JfHxZpTPU0LSRXu9IKpWHAcfGpGBN5Nigkcnb3qJUeowiBtGFzdwUE7E2b60jTcp3u1AiP_1Pv-MjeZ2abJKKi0iC96MujXB6_9Hva5jRN2i-I3thWRQ2L0nJ5TJyGiD1PRp50RNvHumpLjRgD9-ZHHlpTl_CIANYF8CoTQJaHHtG)
Neither of my parents finished high school. But they worked as if the sun were always going down, and they believed - truly believed - that their kids would go further than they did.

I was the first in my family to go to college. And while I was there, I lost them both. Mom and Dad, died within two years of each other. I came home on weekends to keep the business going and helped raise my little sister, Darline, who was just 13.

I didn't have a safety net. I had no choice but to climb.

_**That's the South Carolina way. That's the American way.**_

After law school, I put on the uniform. I became a U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate - military prosecutor, defense attorney. Even after South Carolinians sent me to the Senate, I kept serving in the Reserves. I've been to Afghanistan. I've been to Iraq. I've stood next to kids from small towns just like Central who signed up because they believe in something bigger than themselves.

That's why I fight so hard, because I know exactly what's at stake.

The people coming to our family's pool hall after a long week - they weren't asking for much. Safe streets. A fair shot. A chance to build something. Those are the same things Americans want today.

And the folks on the other side of the aisle? They're perfectly happy to hand your neighborhood over to open borders, pile new taxes on your paycheck, and tell you to be grateful for it.

I won't stand for it. _Not for a second._

clean_body: I was the first in my family to go to college. | Fellow American - Let me tell you something they don't teach you in Washington. I grew up in the back of a bar. Not a fancy restaurant. Not a supper club. A beer joint, pool hall, and liquor store on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - the Sanitary Cafe. My parents ran it. We lived behind it. I swept the floors, wiped down the tables, and fell asleep listening to the sounds of working people winding down after a long shift at the textile mill. Neither of my parents finished high school. But they worked as if the sun were always going down, and they believed - truly believed - that their kids would go further than they did. I was the first in my family to go to college. And while I was there, I lost them both. Mom and Dad, died within two years of each other. I came home on weekends to keep the business going and helped raise my little sister, Darline, who was just 13. I didn't have a safety net. I had no choice but to climb. That's the South Carolina way. That's the American way. After law school, I put on the uniform. I became a U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate - military prosecutor, defense attorney. Even after South Carolinians sent me to the Senate, I kept serving in the Reserves. I've been to Afghanistan. I've been to Iraq. I've stood next to kids from small towns just like Central who signed up because they believe in something bigger than themselves. That's why I fight so hard, because I know exactly what's at stake. The people coming to our family's pool hall after a long week - they weren't asking for much. Safe streets. A fair shot. A chance to build something. Those are the same things Americans want today. And the folks on the other side of the aisle? They're perfectly happy to hand your neighborhood over to open borders, pile new taxes on your paycheck, and tell you to be grateful for it. I won't stand for it. Not for a second. We are in a fight for the future of this country, and it is not a time to sit on the sidelines. I didn't come from money. I came from a bar in South Carolina, a mother who worked hard, and a faith that hard work still means something in America. It still does. Thank you for standing with me. God bless you, and God bless South Carolina. name: Troy Downing
subject: “These things we do, that others may live.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
I traded a comfortable life to fly rescue missions in Afghanistan

| Peter,
How many members of Congress do you know who can fly nearly every type of aircraft, have developed a successful tech startup and enlisted in the Air Force at 34 years old?
My name is Troy Downing – can you give me just a couple of minutes of your time to share my story? I promise you, it's not going to be one you'll forget.
In my youth, I helped develop graphics technology at an NYU lab that won an Academy Award and built a successful startup that merged with Yahoo!
And in 2001, I had a beautiful life. I went from a dirt-poor childhood to having a beautiful wife, a home, and four kids of my own.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
Then came September 11th.
Like millions of Americans, I watched the horror of that day unfold. But as a 34-year-old businessman, I couldn't just sit back and watch others fight for our freedom.
I knew I had to give back to the country that gave me everything.
I walked right into a military recruitment office, looked the recruiter in the eye, and said, "Hey, I have a commercial pilot's license, I used to teach math at NYU – what can you do with me?"
I signed on the dotted line, went to boot camp, and proudly joined a U.S. Air Force Combat Search and Rescue squadron.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._ig)
---
I served eight years and did two tours of duty in Afghanistan on grueling rescue missions to save wounded soldiers on the battlefield. Our squadron lived by a sacred motto:
“These things we do, that others may live.”
And after two tours in Afghanistan, the good people of Montana elected me to the U.S. House of Representatives – I’ve even been endorsed by President Trump TWICE!
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-QCBQbbZ2ylcQFcRpeA)
---
But right now, the battlefield has changed – and the stakes have never been higher. I am running for re-election to Congress, and every single seat in these Midterms matters if we want to protect and defend our GOP House Majority.
Peter, I’m not someone who loves asking for money. In fact, it’s one of the hardest parts of this job. But the reality of modern campaigns is that I cannot fight this battle alone. I don’t need a small fortune from a few wealthy insiders – I need a strong team of everyday patriots standing in the trenches with me.
If you believe that Washington needs more leaders who put country over self, and if you want to make sure our House of Representatives stays firmly in conservative hands, I would be deeply grateful for your support.
[If you are able, would you consider making a humble, secure contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today? Every dollar, every CENT goes directly toward defending this seat and keeping our GOP House Majority alive.](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN $25](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN $50](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-lYwEWGPWu6_E5OAdgw)
---
Thank you for your time, your support, and your shared love for this country.
God Bless you,
Troy Downing
U.S. Representative, Montana's 2nd District
---

**SOUTH DAKOTA SURPRISE!** **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** member Rep. Heather Baxter just won the GOP nomination for Secretary of State, putting a principled conservative on track to oversee elections in South Dakota.But Baxter's win is part of a bigger story.Freedom Caucus members are increasingly running -- and winning -- the offices that run elections: **⚡️Missouri:** Former **Missouri Freedom Caucus** State Senator Denny Hoskins is the current Secretary of State. **⚡️Wyoming:** Founding **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** member Chuck Gray is current Secretary of State. **⚡️South Dakota:** Current **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** member Rep. Heather Baxter just won the GOP nomination and will be the heavy favorite in November.**⚡️Arizona:** As we have reported before, current **Arizona Freedom Caucus** member Rep. Alex Kolodin is running for Secretary of State. **⚡️Wyoming:** Current **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** chair Rep. Rachel Rodriguez-Williams is running to replace Gray, who is running for Congress.The Secretary of State controls how elections are administered -- voter rolls, ballot access, transparency rules, certification, etc. These aren't ceremonial offices. Freedom Caucus Secretaries of State will fight to clean up voter rolls, enforce transparency requirements, and ensure only American citizens are casting ballots. The establishment has long controlled these offices quietly.We're changing that.

| | One year ago, Senate Republicans passed Donald Trump's Big Beautiful Betrayal and Trump signed it into law. After a 27-hour vote-a-rama and after voting down every Democratic amendment that would have protected families — Republicans passed this "Families lose, Billionaires win" giveaway. And the more people learn about this bill, the more they hate it. **One year later, we can see exactly what this bill has done to our country.** Devastating cuts to Medicaid that Americans rely on to get health care. Gutting SNAP benefits that help families put food on the table, including for hundreds of thousands of children. And the billionaires who were handed massive tax breaks are doing just fine. **The Republican vision for this bill was never a secret: families lose, billionaires win.** As we approach the Fourth of July, I find myself thinking about what Independence Day actually asks of us. It's a reminder that the promise of this country, liberty and justice for all, has never been handed to us. It is something we've had to fight for. We see that fighting spirit in the past year in the folks who have shown up at the No Kings rallies, in those who have helped their neighbors through tough times, and in every American who is looking at what's happening to our democracy and refusing to look away. **That same spirit is what got us through this past year, and it's what will carry us forward.** Our democracy is being tested, but I know that when we rise up together and fight for a better future, we will win. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41500%2E3422442%2EZ7NxaR)
Peter,
The reason Congress keeps failing working people isn't a mystery—**it's corporate cash.** Lobbyists write the checks, politicians cash them, and the rest of us pay the price.
**Truth to Power is here to change that equation.**
We fuel candidates who reject corporate PAC money and are running to actually deliver for people: nationwide abortion access, lower costs for working families, and a government that protects our environment instead of selling it off to the highest bidder.
These aren't easy races. These are candidates in competitive primaries and purple districts who are willing to take on the fight— _because that's how you actually change the norm, not just the talking points._
When we back candidates who refuse to play by the old rules, we build a Congress that isn't beholden to the powerful and start delivering the change people are demanding.
Our work is 100% grassroots-funded. No corporate money, no lobbyist checks—just people who are done waiting for the establishment to fix itself.

I spent part of last weekend at the Millville Firemen's Carnival, and I came away with something I'm still thinking about.
There was a display of veterans -- photos of hundreds of people from our community who served this country, going all the way back to the Civil War. I stood there for a few minutes and took it all in. Their faces, their stories, their service.
Every single one of those veterans showed up for something bigger than themselves. For us. For our community. For our country.
**250 years in, our country is in a tough moment. It feels like we are divided in ways I 've never seen in my lifetime. But we get to decide what we want to do about it. What kind of country we want to be. And how we show up for each other.**
Not by pretending we agree on everything. But by remembering that at the end of the day, we all want better things for our community.
That common ground is real. I've seen it here in PA-09, in the conversations I'm having every single day. People are frustrated, but they haven't given up on each other.
That's not who we are. And it's not what we want for our future. We deserve better, and we can make it a reality together.
Happy 250th. Let's make it count.
- Rachel Wallace

Peter,
A critical bipartisan housing bill was poised to be signed into law by the president. A signing ceremony was scheduled to take place in the Capitol rotunda. The podium and stage were set up and the cameras were in position.
But at the last second, Donald Trump took to Truth Social and announced the signing ceremony was canceled, and issued an ultimatum to Congress: Pass the most restrictive voting legislation in American history or the housing bill is dead:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0017s4HkjgGzJpHaq1qG4YqbEyTHNisfYc0jskl936T9HVsSCnKDECsLLiCJ9pWT25N9lj7qn9I2kok-69I1_eeA0XF0Ichluz8DFfvuUcTsVQ_LY53Qy47iyR5XdOU-g18u3pdCSKPgUUO_MAAG7ts5KasWT4Kmxhpd_46GFr3bpvjKXvMKbjRfLAXC_LPtbf3ojqGWakRU1gQnmmsOqeqjul75ZvxhqSTA5AfKEmYoIU=&c=n9fvyBW4wYVo8FuzG5_Th-GQylWRcUE0mfC2lmzCbTkfR-NNU1rjeQ==&ch=iObPAcbeMjJ9etWP_uKatPfTQoHw4003H_-dof9ZOrNh81aaPNMnGQ==)

Trump is now taking the American economy hostage to try and rig the upcoming midterms.
Although not perfect, the bill is a major step in the right direction towards solving America's housing and affordability crisis. The bill heavily restricts large institutional investors from buying up single-family homes, boosts housing stock, expands rural housing grants, and modernizes mortgage financing.
The SAVE Act on the other hand, is the most sweeping voter suppression law in American history. It would disenfranchise millions of voters, disproportionately Black and minority voters. In some states, it could end mail-in voting. It would also open the door to intimidating election workers with threats of prosecution. It is so extreme, that even some GOP Senators are refusing to support it.
In an attempt to persuade those GOP holdouts to support the SAVE Act, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller went to social media and just flat out admitted the true purpose of the bill like some cartoon villain revealing his master plan:

Democrats everywhere must fight back. Our democracy depends on it. Defend Our Courts is leading that charge, and we are fighting on two fronts. First, we are building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections, state by state. Second, we are building the movement to reclaim a United States Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.

The SAVE Act on the other hand, is the most sweeping voter suppression law in American history. It would disenfranchise millions of voters, disproportionately Black and minority voters. In some states, it could end mail-in voting. It would also open the door to intimidating election workers with threats of prosecution. It is so extreme, that even some GOP Senators are refusing to support it. In an attempt to persuade those GOP holdouts to support the SAVE Act, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller went to social media and just flat out admitted the true purpose of the bill like some cartoon villain revealing his master plan: | == Every single day the Trump administration comes out with a new villainous plot to rig elections. This latest attempt shows just how desperate Trump really is. And as he gets more desperate, he only gets more dangerous. Democrats everywhere must fight back. Our democracy depends on it. Defend Our Courts is leading that charge, and we are fighting on two fronts. First, we are building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections, state by state. Second, we are building the movement to reclaim a United States Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration. == | | | == | == | == | | | == | == | == | | | | == | In solidarity, Defend Our Courts | | | | | | | | | | == | | | | | == | | | | Mail checks to: | | | | Defend Our CourtsP.O. name: Clayton Tucker
subject: Thank you for joining us last month
body:
We're building something special

| | |
---
---
Howdy Peter! Clayton Tucker here, just wanted to write you a personal note. I want to thank you, personally, for showing interest in our community of organized people fighting organized money — whether that's by signing one of our petitions, signing up on our website, or simply being curious what we're about. Either way, I'm glad you took action last month to join us. I wanted to let you know that, because of the support we received from thousands of folks just like you, we reached our goals in June. We'll be releasing our numbers shortly, but what I will tell you now is that we hit our goal of 1,000+ first-time donors in June and we hit our major goal of raising $400,000+ thus far in this campaign — more than any grassroots TX Ag Comm campaign since Jim Hightower (at least at this stage of the campaign). This was all possible because of regular folks like you. We have a long road ahead of us. Only organized people can beat organized money. We'll need your support over the 123 days (but who's counting lol). We're asking folks to help us build our grassroots base. If you want to help get some of your friends and family to join our community, here are some quick ways to start:
* If you yourself haven't already joined us, I ask that you consider doing so. [**You can fully join our community by pitching in today.**](https://donate.claytontuckertx.com/?e=a1313c0e9f6a9c38a4fba3102a3a2800&utm_source=cht&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=260702em_junejoined&n=1)
* If you have nothing to spare, I understand. I've been there, it's a tough place to be. There are other ways to become a member of our campaign. **[You can become a volunteer](https://www.claytontuckertx.com/volunteer?e=a1313c0e9f6a9c38a4fba3102a3a2800&utm_source=cht&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=260702em_junejoined&n=2)** or [**you can become a recruiter**](https://www.claytontuckertx.com/recruit?e=a1313c0e9f6a9c38a4fba3102a3a2800&utm_source=cht&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=260702em_junejoined&n=3).
* If you'd prefer to look into us first, I understand. If you have any questions, please let us know.

I appreciate you and the 10s of thousands of Texans helping us build something truly special.
---
Stay strong, Clayton
---

name: Voto Latino
subject: Despite the attacks, we must embrace and uphold our democracy.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Tomorrow is the United States’ 250th birthday.
#
Peter,
**Tomorrow is the United States’ 250th birthday.**
On a day when we are supposed to celebrate our freedom, we can’t help but acknowledge the clear divide in our nation.
We are witnessing a rise in hate and systemic attacks from the Trump administration aimed directly at members of our community.
From aggressive ICE operations tearing families apart and wrongfully incarcerating members of our community to federal attempts to police mail-in voting through the USPS, the attacks have been relentless. We’re also seeing nationwide gerrymandering efforts designed to strip us of our voice, and earlier this year, the highest court in the land even sided with Trump to further dilute the Voting Rights Act.
ALL of this has happened in just the last year and a half since Trump took office, Peter.
**And yet, despite all the attacks from the Trump administration meant to discourage us,_we must keep up the fight to uphold our democracy._**
Over our history, Voto Latino has registered over 1.8 million voters, built enduring political power, and fought to modernize our democracy to reflect a truly multiracial society. This milestone is a testament to that collective impact, because none of this transformative work happens without the partners and supporters who stand with us every single day.
This recognition truly belongs to our entire community as we continue pushing forward together to protect our future at the ballot box this November.
Thank you,
Voto Latino

name: Tim Walz
subject: What patriotism means to me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
Patriotism is not about who can shout the loudest. It’s about who we fight for.
#
Peter,
Ahead of the Fourth of July, I’ve been thinking about what patriotism means to me.
Not the performative kind. Not the kind that gets wrapped up in slogans, cable news hits, or politicians trying to prove who can shout the loudest. I mean the kind of patriotism I learned growing up in a small town:
Your neighbor’s kid deserves a good public school. A veteran deserves the care they earned. A teacher, farmer, nurse, factory worker, and small business owner all deserve dignity, opportunity, and a fair shot.
But right now, Donald Trump, MAGA politicians, billionaire donors, and tech bros are trying to sell us a very different idea of patriotism.
They wrap themselves in the flag while cutting services working families rely on. They talk about “real America” while ignoring the people who keep our communities running. And they pit us against each other so we don’t notice who keeps getting more power, more money, and more say.
**That’s not patriotism to me.**
Patriotism is believing our communities are worth fighting for. It’s standing up for your neighbors. It’s refusing to accept an America where working people are divided and distracted while the richest people in the room call the shots.
I launched Small Town PAC not just to win elections for the sake of winning elections — but to help elect leaders who believe in that same kind of patriotism. Leaders who know their communities, respect working people, and understand that public service is supposed to mean serving the public.
But leaders like that do not win because we hope they will. They win because people like us decide early that they are worth fighting for.
[**That’s why I’m asking directly before the holiday weekend begins, will you make a contribution to Small Town PAC to help elect Democrats who will fight for the America we believe in?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260703-1.PNr__3&amount=5&refcode=em20260703-830&t=2&akid=830%2E34582%2EX9qUZS)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260703-1.PNr__3&amount=5&refcode=20260703-830&t=21&akid=830%2E34582%2EX9qUZS)**
Patriotism is not about pretending America is perfect. It is about loving this country enough to make it better.
Thanks for being in this fight,
Tim Walz

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260703-830&t=22&refcode2=830_34582_X9qUZS&akid=830%2E34582%2EX9qUZS)**

I launched Small Town PAC not just to win elections for the sake of winning elections — but to help elect leaders who believe in that same kind of patriotism. Leaders who know their communities, respect working people, and understand that public service is supposed to mean serving the public. But leaders like that do not win because we hope they will. They win because people like us decide early that they are worth fighting for. Patriotism is not about pretending America is perfect. It is about loving this country enough to make it better. Thanks for being in this fight, Tim Walz Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America. Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.

For 250 years, America has been the greatest nation on Earth - not because government made us great, but because freedom did.
We became a magnet for the most talented, hardworking people in the world. We rewarded innovation. We celebrated success. We believed that if you worked hard and played by the rules, you could build a better life for yourself and your family.
That's the America I grew up believing in.
Unfortunately, there are people today who want to take us in a different direction.
The modern Left is increasingly embracing the failed ideas of socialism, government dependency, and resentment toward those who succeed. They don't want to expand opportunity - they want to redistribute it.
I reject that vision completely.
I believe Ohio can lead the nation by proving that freedom still works. That capitalism still works. That hard work should be rewarded - not punished.

Hi,
Tomorrow is the Fourth of July, and I hope you get to spend it with family and friends. Before the holiday, I wanted to share something personal about my own family.
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio. My dad was a doctor. My mom was a teacher. Between the two of them, I learned what it means to work hard and look out for your neighbors like they are your own family.
Those are the family values I grew up with. And to me, they’re American values too.
**Because that’s what patriotism really is. Not a slogan on a hat. It’s looking out for people – especially the ones who’ve been left behind. It’s fighting for the folks who make this country work.**
That’s why I’m back in this: For the people who punch a clock, work on farms and factory floors, raise kids, care for aging parents, work double shifts – and do everything right while the cost of living keeps climbing.
But the truth is that the people in charge in Washington are doing everything they can to stop our pro-worker movement because they know if we win in Ohio, we win the Senate.
That’s why GOP super PACs are spending over $100 million to attack me in a race that is on track to become the most expensive Senate race in history.
**But it’s patriotic to stand up for what’s right.** And it’s right that working people have a voice in the U.S. Senate. The folks I grew up around in Mansfield deserve that voice. All Ohioans deserve that voice.
That’s who I’m fighting for.
We can win this race – the polls show we’re tied – but only if this grassroots team stands with me against the billionaires trying to buy this seat. | | | Friend, **_You won't believe what's happening right now in the heart of New York City._**

An Islamic prayer is being broadcast loudly over speakers **FIVE** **TIMES A DAY** echoing phrases like **"There is no god but Allah"** across streets in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Astoria, and beyond.

_This isn't occasional. _

**It's daily.**

_**It's public.**_

And it's being forced on everyone — Christian, Jewish, atheist, or anyone who simply wants to live in a traditionally American community without foreign religious declarations dominating public spaces.

**Freedom Caucus Member Rep. Andy Ogles just called it out plainly and powerfully:**

## An Independence Day message...
This weekend, America is turning 250.
I think any Independence Day is worth celebrating, but this isn't just another anniversary.
It's the story of the greatest political experiment in human history.
The United States has outlasted empires, survived civil war, defeated tyranny, and become the standard by which other nations measure freedom and opportunity.
Makes me pretty proud to be a part of it.
What makes this country great is baked into its DNA: limited government, checks and balances, and a clear-eyed understanding of human nature.
The Founders knew that power corrupts, so they divided it. They knew people aren't angels, so they created a system that turns self-interest into productivity instead of letting it run wild. And they grounded the whole thing in life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
That combination unleashed human potential like nothing before it--how else could it have lasted 250 years?
America went from a collection of colonies in the woods to the beacon of hope for millions.
That's not myth -- it's our history.
And if you ask me, it's worth defending.
For too long, some folks in our own country have treated America like the problem instead of the solution.
They tear down the Founders, rewrite our story as one long tale of oppression, and act like patriotism is bigotry.
Talk about ungrateful.
America 250 is the perfect opportunity to push back on that nonsense.
Recommit to our founding ideals and reform what needs fixing, yes.
But we should celebrate what makes us exceptional.
The American experiment has lasted this long because the principles are timeless and the system is resilient.
Is it perfect? No.
But it's still the best thing we've got on this side of Heaven.
As we mark 250 years, let's stop apologizing for this country and start defending it with pride.
The world still looks to America as the standard. It's time we remembered why.

This weekend, America is turning 250. I think any Independence Day is worth celebrating, but this isn't just another anniversary. It's the story of the greatest political experiment in human history. The United States has outlasted empires, survived civil war, defeated tyranny, and become the standard by which other nations measure freedom and opportunity.
